races.paceDynamic: Look This Way, Babs, and Risk De Cerisy will set a relentless gallop from the start, with three confirmed front runners ensuring no hiding place in this 14-runner maiden. The strong early pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the final 3 furlongs. Hold-up horses like Great Dance, G Whizz, and Crystal Jet will get the perfect setup as the pace-setters tire, while prominent runners may find themselves caught between groups. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can pick up the pieces when the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners maintain a strong gallop to halfway before weakening
scenarios.body: The relentless early pace will set up perfectly for horses held up in rear who can unleash late runs. Patient tactics will be rewarded as the pace collapses in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can position perfectly behind the pace-setters
scenarios.body: Crystal Days or Elated could track the leaders without doing too much early work and have enough left to strike. The pace will still be strong enough to set it up for those just behind the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes more measured than expected with one leader getting first run
scenarios.body: Babs has winning form on good ground and could dictate from the front if the other two leaders don't cooperate. A more tactical race would suit her experience and proven stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly unsustainable and collapses dramatically in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: The race could fall apart completely, allowing an unfancied hold-up horse to come from nowhere. Cushendall has winning form and could benefit from a truly-run race despite his low rating.

watchPoints.text: Look This Way and Babs both show tendency to fade in finish despite being front runners - if both go hard early they could collapse
Crystal Jet carries 5lb claiming jockey Isabelle Ryder but has winning form and ideal hold-up style for this pace setup
Great Dance has strongest recent form with a win last time and hold-up style perfectly suits expected pace scenario
Risk De Cerisy from in-form Dan Skelton yard likely to ensure strong pace but question marks over stamina at finish
Crystal Days and Elated both represent Ben Pauling who has 2 runners - watch for stable tactics between the pair

runners_data.spotlight: No match for Irish Chorus here in March but she's got a handy pull in the weights with that rival and she lost a shoe when beaten 12l at Stratford; not discounted.

runners_data.name: Uncle Phil
runners_data.note: Lone front runner who controls the tactical narrative but trainer has no recent runners for guidance

runners_data.name: Irish Chorus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent form but faces pace-shape disadvantage alongside In This World

runners_data.name: Neigh Botha
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying just 153lbs after 164-day break with strong course record

runners_data.name: Lacrima
runners_data.note: Young prominent type with recent win but stepping up significantly in class for inexperienced trainer

races.paceDynamic: Uncle Phil is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. With Yes Indeed, Tommy Cullen, Politacus, Neigh Botha and Lacrima all positioned prominently behind him, there's depth to the early positions but no genuine pace pressure. Irish Chorus and In This World are the only hold-up horses, leaving them reliant on Uncle Phil maintaining a searching gallop throughout. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours prominent racers and the lone leader, as the hold-up pair face a tactical disadvantage in a race lacking genuine early burn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Uncle Phil maintains a steady rhythm without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when ready. The prominent horses behind struggle to bridge the gap as he controls the tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet apply pressure to Uncle Phil from halfway
scenarios.body: Uncle Phil's bold front running comes under sustained pressure as multiple prominent racers close in. One of the stronger prominent horses like Tommy Cullen or Yes Indeed capitalizes on their tracking position to prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Uncle Phil sets genuinely strong fractions despite the lack of early pace
scenarios.body: The sustained tempo stretches the field and allows Irish Chorus or In This World to unleash their finishing kicks. Their class tells as the early pace takes its toll on the front division.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Range Assault
scenarios.trigger: If Neigh Botha or Lacrima make their move approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The lighter-weighted horses use their handicap advantage to strike early and maintain momentum. Their tactical boldness catches the pace-setter and other prominent horses off guard.

watchPoints.text: Uncle Phil could steal this if allowed uncontested lead as no other genuine pace-setters will pressure him early
Irish Chorus and In This World both rely heavily on strong pace development that may not materialize
Tommy Cullen returning after 183-day layoff despite strong historical form on good going
Neigh Botha carries significant weight advantage at 153lbs which could prove decisive in tight finish
Multiple prominent runners could create mid-race cavalry charge if they coordinate pressure on Uncle Phil

races.paceDynamic: Georges Street will take the early lead with only limited company from prominent runners Reforme, Sir Rock and Half Pint Daisy. This creates an uncontested front-running scenario where Georges Street can dictate terms without pressure, likely producing a steady gallop that quickens late. The bulk of the field contains hold-up horses (Spitalfield, Cinderello, Lady Harriett, Jet Joe) who will rely on the pace collapsing. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the gentle pace and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Georges Street gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter faces minimal early pressure and can control the race tactically before finding extra in the straight. Hold-up horses struggle to close the gap from too far back against a horse who hasn't been softened up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow for Georges Street
scenarios.body: Reforme or Sir Rock can track the leader closely and have more tactical speed when the race develops in earnest. The front runner pays for making the running while prominent horses get first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Cinderello or Spitalfield benefit from their hold-up style as the race becomes a pure stamina test over the final half-mile. Their fresh legs tell against horses who've been closer to the pace throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Muddle Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding produces a stop-start gallop with multiple pace changes
scenarios.body: Half Pint Daisy or Lady Harriett can pick up the pieces when the race falls apart tactically. Their versatile styles allow them to adapt when others struggle with the changing tempo.

watchPoints.text: Georges Street must prove he can see out this longer trip after recent efforts suggest stamina limitations
Spitalfield needs the cheekpieces to spark improvement after a dire run of form this year
Sir Rock carries significant fitness concerns after 178 days off the track despite his class advantage
Jet Joe has shown a pattern of fading in the finish which could be fatal over this staying trip
Half Pint Daisy needs to find significant improvement to trouble these despite her consistent efforts

races.paceDynamic: Another Folly will lead this field from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to challenge the early tempo. This creates a comfortable, uncontested pace scenario where the leader can dictate fractions without pressure through the early and middle stages. Imperial Bede, Full Force Gale and Dj Pete will track in behind but none are aggressive early types. This measured tempo strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the lack of early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Another Folly gets easy fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The Jane Williams runner controls every call without pressure and has enough left to resist late challengers. His soft lead setup negates the hold-up horses' usual finishing advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and sets up a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The slow tempo allows the back-markers to unleash devastating late runs with maximum energy reserves. Harel Du Marais and Theonlywayiswessex benefit most from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Bede or Full Force Gale get ideal stalking positions
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can monitor Another Folly's move while staying close enough to pounce when the leader weakens. Their tactical positioning proves optimal for this intermediate pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Another Folly stops quickly and creates a chaotic finish
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina gives out completely, turning the race into a messy sprint where any horse can capitalize. Form and class become secondary to who finds the best late run.

watchPoints.text: Another Folly must be monitored closely for signs of stopping as his recent fourth-place efforts suggest stamina concerns
Imperial Bede's early positioning will be crucial - if he gets too far back the uncontested pace may not suit his style
Theonlywayiswessex needs to show early signs of fitness given the long absence or he becomes backable at bigger odds
The pace through halfway will determine everything - if it's genuinely slow the hold-up horses become very dangerous
Start Again's jumping on chase debut must be watched as any mistakes will end his chances from off the pace

races.paceDynamic: Continuance will lead from the outset with no genuine pace pressure, allowing him to dictate a comfortable rhythm through the early stages. The prominent runners Jaminska, Wild Goose, Wondering Why and Gentleman Joe will track behind in a pack, while the hold-up horses Nap Hand, Turn And Finish and Seraphic will be anchored towards the rear. This controlled tempo will set up a sprint finish where positioning and tactical acumen become crucial. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the front-runner's fate if the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady until the home turn then quickens
scenarios.body: The tracking pack gets first run on the tiring leader while the hold-up horses are caught too far back. Jaminska and Wild Goose are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their class and recent form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching from halfway
scenarios.body: The early speed collapses dramatically in the final furlong, allowing the closers to sweep past. Nap Hand's class tells while Turn And Finish benefits from his long absence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Continuance maintains his kick when challenged
scenarios.body: The front-runner's extended break pays dividends as he finds extra when the field closes, holding off late challengers. His tactical position proves unbeatable despite the long layoff.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to race up with Continuance
scenarios.body: The entire field bunches up creating a cavalry charge finish where any horse can win. The lightest weighted Seraphic or the freshest Wondering Why could capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Continuance's jumping under no early pressure - any mistake could end his chances when the field is still bunched
Turn And Finish's fitness after 162 days off - may need the run despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace
Wild Goose's response to first-time tongue-tie which could provide the edge needed off top weight
Nap Hand's positioning early - needs to be handy enough if the kick comes sooner than expected
Jaminska's jumping rhythm if tracking too close to a steady pace - may get impatient and make errors

races.paceDynamic: Mistral Blue will take the early lead with minimal opposition, as most of this field are hold-up merchants and prominent racers. With only Shesonnet and Luna Run likely to track the pace early, Mistral Blue can dictate comfortable fractions through the opening stages without serious pressure. The lack of genuine pace angles means the tempo will be moderate rather than searching, allowing the leaders to stay in contention longer than usual. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent racers and early leaders who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mistral Blue Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Mistral Blue gets an uncontested lead and sets sustainable fractions.
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can use her tactical speed to build a winning margin before the hold-up brigade can mount their challenge. Her recent good form at this trip and proven front-running ability make her the logical beneficiary of this race shape.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the large pack of hold-up horses get bunched up and struggle for racing room.
scenarios.body: The congestion will prevent several fancied runners from getting clear runs, allowing a horse with a good position and strong finishing kick to capitalise. Those that get the clearest passage will have a significant advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Shesonnet or Luna Run press Mistral Blue early and create a genuine pace duel.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will set up the race for a strong closer to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. This scenario opens the door for the best of the hold-up horses who can avoid trouble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If even Mistral Blue goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish from the last flight.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing speed rather than stamina, suiting horses with natural pace regardless of their usual tactics. The draw and positioning becomes crucial in a bunch finish.

watchPoints.text: Mistral Blue could get too easy a lead early and prove hard to peg back if allowed to dictate the pace uncontested
The large group of hold-up horses may cause significant traffic problems from the last flight, watch for those getting clear runs
Hello Cello's headgear return and Harry Fry's horses running well recently makes her dangerous if getting the right trip
Jlow's recent good form and bottom weight could be significant if the pace sets up right for hold-up horses
Luna Run's long absence is a concern but her low weight and prominent style could suit if needing the run
